lines.trans: Nina, look what I found! A fishing rod!

words.gram: female given name, used as address

lines.trans: It's the first time I've seen anyone scare people with a fishing rod.
There's fishing line and a sharp hook here. It's very painful!
Samson, I don't understand. Don't you want the flat?

words.gram: nickname of Ivan Samsonov, used as address
future, 1st person singular, perfective (idiomatic for 'I can't understand')

lines.trans: I want a fishing rod. Both that one and the other one!

words.gram: correlative conjunction и ... и = both ... and

lines.trans: No you can't!

words.gloss: no you can't, it's not allowed

lines.trans: And what if there is no flat?

words.gram: genitive singular, feminine (with negative не будет)

lines.trans: With an attitude like that, of course there won't be.
Stop it! We will have the flat.

words.gloss: there will be, we will have

lines.trans: All right. Shall we show this to Anikeev?
Have you lost your mind? He won't be scared!

words.gram: preposition + genitive; сойти с ума = to lose one's mind

words.gloss: stepped down (сошёл с ума = gone crazy)

lines.trans: Right, we are not joking, understood? Find a scarier tool.
Oh, look, cheap and effective!

words.gloss: effective (lit. angry; idiom и дёшево, и сердито)

lines.trans: And at the same time I'll trim the branches in the yard.

words.gloss: at the same time, while I'm at it
